Advancing Industry Since 1995
IAQ Group supports the world’s evolving industries through integrated engineering, construction and facility solutions. We combine technical expertise with disciplined execution to deliver facilities that perform today and adapt for tomorrow.

31 years of technical excellence through various service model with global presence across 7 countries
IAQ is a leading ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certified Malaysian owned company that delivers engineering and design consultation, procurement, construction, commissioning and testing, tool installation and maintenance services of plants and on-board project management services to client in diverse industries both locally and globally.
